title: Beyond Top Words: MonoTM for Topic Modeling with Interpretable Monosemantic Features
task: Interpretable topic modelling with semantic units richer than single words
problem: Top-ranked words give a limited description of topics; it is unclear how interpretability of SAE features relates to topic-inference quality.
architecture: Documents are embedded with llama-embed-nemotron-8b (4096-d); top-K sparse autoencoders are trained per corpus; an LLM Interpreter proposes natural-language labels for SAE features and an LLM Predictor validates them; MonoTM first estimates document-topic mixtures with LDA over the full SAE bag-of-features (activation magnitudes as token weights) and then, with mixtures fixed, learns topic descriptors over validated, corpus-grounded features.
llm_or_encoder: NVIDIA llama-embed-nemotron-8b embeddings; Gemma-3 (12B, 27B) as Interpreter/Predictor

datasets.name: Reuters
datasets.details: Reuters-21578 ModApte split, labels with at least 30 occurrences, 47 topics, multi-label

metrics: Micro-F1 and Macro-F1 of document-topic mixtures against gold labels
baselines: other neural topic models producing document-topic mixtures
key_results: On 20 Newsgroups with N = 0.5, raising SAE sparsity K from 8 to 32 lowers the fraction of features with interpretability score >= 0.80 from 35.2% to 13.8% while Micro/Macro F1 rises from 0.56/0.52 to 0.66/0.63, showing a tension between interpretability and mixture quality.
On Reuters, BoW-LDA has the highest Micro-F1 but BoF+LDA has the best Macro-F1, i.e. SAE features help minority topics.
strengths: Decouples mixture estimation from interpretation, so each uses the SAE configuration best suited to it.
Topic descriptors are validated natural-language features grounded in the corpus, aimed at social-science and digital-humanities use.

limitations.text: Excluded low-validation features may still encode important corpus-specific cues.
Interpretability scores depend on the Interpreter/Predictor LLMs, prompts and decoding settings.
Many LLM calls make the method computationally expensive and slow for iterative workflows.

notes: Evaluation against gold categories rather than coherence metrics.
